column1: # Heating modes. Hemma: 18 °C in the living room and the study, the bedroom cold. Sova: those two cold, the bedroom 17 °C. Borta: all cold (12 °C).
# Schedule: Borta Wed-Thu 09-15, Sova 19-06 every day, Hemma otherwise. Around each switch both modes count for an hour: a room that gets warmer
# starts an hour early, a room that gets colder waits an hour, and during that hour a degree short is enough (heat_overlap_slack).
# A mode chosen by hand holds until auto; manual (chosen on the page or a target changed in the UI) leaves the targets alone until a mode or auto
# is chosen; a setpoint changed on a thermostat does so only until the schedule's next switch.
# In heat_mode program the target follows the planner's program.<room> (the schedule's while it has none).
